Silver Tempest

Released November 11, 2022 · 215 cards

StandardExpanded

Silver Tempest is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sword & Shield series, released in English on November 11, 2022. Its main set has 195 cards, plus 20 secret rares numbered beyond the set (215 in total). It includes 177 Pokémon, 35 Trainer and 3 Energy cards, and is legal in the Standard and Expanded formats.

Illustrators

84 illustrators worked on Silver Tempest. Most cards: N-DESIGN Inc. (13), PLANETA Mochizuki (10), Ryuta Fuse (7), 5ban Graphics (6), AYUMI ODASHIMA (5), Hideki Ishikawa (5), Jiro Sasumo (5), Ken Sugimori (5).
